integrity: The quasismoothness reduction is proved from the published coordinate-subset criterion, the canonical strip is independently reconstructed from local Reid--Tai ages, and the packaged checker reproduces all finite verification claims.
limitations: The density result is only an upper bound; no sharp asymptotic is claimed. Exhaustive computation is finite and supports, but does not replace, the proof.
title: A divisibility criterion for quasismooth anticanonical hypersurfaces in two-heavy-weight projective spaces
